title: The More You Rescue, The More They Sink
coreMove: Wanting someone's recovery more than they do never works. You can love, protect safety, and offer tools, but the healing itself has to stay theirs to carry.

exampleSpecs.audience: Pia and readers facing rescue versus support
exampleSpecs.stakes: Ownership cannot be transferred without weakening the person who needs strength.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Pia using rescue versus support in the source case without controlling another person.
